specHint: Draft model proposes k tokens, target verifies in one pass. Effective speed ≈ base ÷ (1 + k·c_draft) × (1 + k·α), draft cost c≈0.2. Higher α or smaller k → bigger win.
ctxHalfAria: Context depth at which decode speed has halved
ctxChartLabel: Instantaneous decode speed vs output depth
ctxChartAria: Decode speed decay curve as the KV cache fills
ctxProbeAria: Drag to inspect decode speed at a given output depth
ctxProbeReadout: at +{generated} generated tok · cache ≈ {cache} tok · {speed} tok/s ({pct}% of base)
ctxHint: Bandwidth model: every decode step re-reads the weights plus the whole KV cache, so time per token grows linearly with cache depth. C½ is the depth where speed has halved — walltime, TPOT and the simulation clock all follow this curve.
outputLengthAria: Target output generation length in tokens
resetTooltip: Reset simulation (phase, token progress, stream, elapsed time)
prefillHint: Compute-bound parallel matrix multiplication. Builds the KV cache for all {tokens} prompt tokens.
decodeHint: Memory-bandwidth bound autoregressive loop. Reads all model weights & KV cache per generated token.
kvSectionLabel: KV cache growth — prefill writes every row at once, decode adds one row per token
kvPrefillCaption: Compute-bound: the whole matrix is written in a single forward pass — every cache row fills together.
kvDecodeCaption: Memory-bound: each generated token appends exactly one new cache row.
placeholderIdle: Press "Simulate Run" to watch the token stream.
itlVarianceAria: Coefficient of variation of per-token inter-token latency
itlHint: Each token draws its own latency from a mean-preserving lognormal (σ² = ln(1+CV²)): average TPOT stays put while the tail grows. Percentiles are table stakes — batched neighbours, preemption and cache misses all live in that p99.
itlHistogramAria: Histogram of simulated per-token latencies with p50, p95 and p99 markers
itlStreamHint: Decode now follows the drawn schedule token by token — watch the stream stutter through the p95+ spikes instead of gliding at a constant rate.
